name: Containment Box Extraction Procedure
description: Astronaut extracts red box followed by yellow box from the primary containment rack

0.name: IDLE
0.instruction: System initialized. Please open the primary container box.

1.name: CONTAINER_OPEN
1.instruction: Container open. Next step: Please extract the red box.

2.name: RED_EXTRACTED
2.instruction: Red box extracted. Next step: Please extract the yellow box.

3.name: COMPLETE
3.instruction: Yellow box extracted. Experiment successfully completed.

ERROR_SEQ.alert_tts: Warning: Procedural error. Red box must be extracted before yellow box.
ERROR_SEQ.recovery_prompt: Please return the yellow box into the container and proceed with extracting the red box.

ERROR_SKIP.alert_tts: Warning: Step skipped. Please extract the yellow box to complete the procedure.
ERROR_SKIP.recovery_prompt: Please reopen the container and extract the remaining yellow box.

STALL_TIMEOUT.alert_tts: Notice: Activity paused. Please consult mission checklist for active step.
